review_status: AI-written source paraphrases; not independently reviewed by a clinician. Matched only to the exact source explanation hash.

4c372f2040da5696e70d531b3915d4ef9a95991d.what: Less dolutegravir may get into the blood when it is taken with products containing calcium or certain other minerals.
4c372f2040da5696e70d531b3915d4ef9a95991d.why: The source reports reduced uptake of dolutegravir but says the exact reason is not established. Ask a pharmacist to check timing, food, and the exact products before changing how you take them.

081015e12ccf6993eae1dfe260dc6aa615eb2acd.what: Less nelfinavir may get into the blood, which may reduce its effect against HIV.
081015e12ccf6993eae1dfe260dc6aa615eb2acd.why: Nelfinavir needs an acidic stomach to dissolve well. Medicines that greatly reduce stomach acid may interfere with this. Ask the treating doctor about the combination rather than changing treatment yourself.

26e50c7bf8929c53221ae9aa5ddca641a69cbcfe.what: Tacrolimus levels may rise. Long-term use of these acid-reducing medicines may also lower magnesium, a mineral in the blood.
26e50c7bf8929c53221ae9aa5ddca641a69cbcfe.why: The medicines can compete for the body's drug-breakdown processes. Some people are more affected because of inherited differences. The source is uncertain about exactly why magnesium falls.

ac301448fd719dc2907bc9b3d5f5052142c86eb2.what: Quinidine may increase loperamide's effects. The source also describes serious heartbeat risks, particularly when more than the recommended amount of loperamide is used.
ac301448fd719dc2907bc9b3d5f5052142c86eb2.why: Quinidine may allow more loperamide into the blood and brain. Both medicines can affect heartbeat timing. Dose, heart disease, and low blood-mineral levels can change the risk.

de3e23792357172ad0f20a2bc377a8af5b497ef9.what: Less velpatasvir may get into the body when it is used with an acid-reducing medicine such as famotidine.
de3e23792357172ad0f20a2bc377a8af5b497ef9.why: Velpatasvir dissolves better when the stomach is more acidic. Its timing instructions depend on the exact treatment and dose, so a pharmacist should check them.

3af2ccfd34c45446e91be1e1264ff69ade53ca00.what: Methotrexate may build up in the blood. The source particularly raises concern about high-dose treatment and kidney problems; it says the effect with low oral doses is uncertain.
3af2ccfd34c45446e91be1e1264ff69ade53ca00.why: An acid-reducing medicine may slow the kidneys' removal of methotrexate. Ask the treating doctor whether medicine-level or kidney checks are needed.

369ebbab363c6cef5481ae599a27911aafc7e813.what: Less of this type of blood-pressure medicine may get into the body when taken with an antacid. The source describes the expected effect as small.
369ebbab363c6cef5481ae599a27911aafc7e813.why: An antacid may change stomach acidity or how quickly the stomach empties. Ask a pharmacist whether timing matters for your exact products.

78d0218cfb38dbbb17af70504eb1d2133b89c2db.what: Blood sugar may rise, making diabetes harder to control.
78d0218cfb38dbbb17af70504eb1d2133b89c2db.why: Some medicines can raise blood sugar or work against the effect of diabetes medicine.

efd44617bebdb65b7674a396f15240d460de2350.what: Solid potassium chloride tablets or capsules may cause more stomach or bowel injury, including bleeding.
efd44617bebdb65b7674a396f15240d460de2350.why: A medicine that slows movement through the gut can keep the potassium product against the gut lining for longer. The exact potassium product matters.

6803d451760443aabcbba2ea9652e8549612a1f3.what: Blood sugar may become too high or too low when this type of antibiotic is used with diabetes medicine.
6803d451760443aabcbba2ea9652e8549612a1f3.why: These antibiotics may affect how the body releases insulin, which controls blood sugar. The infection itself can also affect blood sugar.

c22ae1805a5ee0044844831230cd4f939088ebe4.what: A steroid medicine may make blood-pressure treatment work less well. Some blood-pressure medicines can also increase steroid effects.
c22ae1805a5ee0044844831230cd4f939088ebe4.why: Steroids can make the body hold more salt and water. Some other medicines can slow the breakdown of the steroid.

c6702361c9e59061ba2f6f099b4d22cdfc68f0ab.what: Blood sugar may rise with long-term use of a steroid on the skin, especially over large areas.
c6702361c9e59061ba2f6f099b4d22cdfc68f0ab.why: Steroids can work against insulin. The amount used, the skin area treated, and how long it is used matter.

67c47b8e0f361c42075374bc4dc168f3aa2cecff.what: These medicines may cause more sleepiness, dizziness, or confusion. Treatment for slow movement of food through the gut may also work less well.
67c47b8e0f361c42075374bc4dc168f3aa2cecff.why: An opioid pain medicine can slow the gut, while the other medicine is intended to speed it up. Some long-acting pain products may also be taken into the body differently.

b166b11d2302692a5fdf44085004c38c0ad6998f.what: Potassium, a mineral in the blood, may fall too low. This could increase the chance of an unusual heartbeat, although evidence is limited.
b166b11d2302692a5fdf44085004c38c0ad6998f.why: Both medicines may lower potassium. The risk can depend on the dose and whether the medicine is inhaled, swallowed, or given another way.

7027fc81db830d46fd9edd98ff483e23ca6585a0.what: Abametapir lotion may increase the amount of certain other medicines in the blood. This possibility is based on laboratory evidence.
7027fc81db830d46fd9edd98ff483e23ca6585a0.why: A substance formed when the body processes abametapir may slow the breakdown of other medicines, even after one application.

c1b8d7d2cc3f78f81f39d4aa7a384bc37112b2ed.what: Bowel preparation or overuse of a laxative may increase heartbeat problems with medicines that already affect heart rhythm.
c1b8d7d2cc3f78f81f39d4aa7a384bc37112b2ed.why: Losing too much potassium or magnesium, minerals in the blood, can make these heart effects more likely. This does not mean every normal laxative dose has the same risk.

830b6b8e219e17ba743ba85bac64645463167e23.what: A supplement thought to boost the immune system may work against a medicine intended to reduce immune activity.
830b6b8e219e17ba743ba85bac64645463167e23.why: Their intended effects may oppose each other. The source describes this as a possible effect based on theory, not a proven outcome.

d4d4b1f3d344758fbc82340f50a904530b6ce77b.what: Blood sugar may fall too low when a medicine that helps the body release insulin is combined with certain other medicines.
d4d4b1f3d344758fbc82340f50a904530b6ce77b.why: The other medicine may increase insulin's effect or increase the amount of diabetes medicine in the blood. The exact reason depends on the medicine pair.

b6194b31cdcf72ca4b86bf34b8148136bf2edd86.what: The source discusses a possible rise in cholesterol-medicine levels and a risk of muscle injury, based on a case report.
b6194b31cdcf72ca4b86bf34b8148136bf2edd86.why: It proposes that changes in how the body moves or breaks down the medicine could leave more in the blood. Ask whether that report applies to your exact medicines.

2b8081e782c348a8fdc2d9702f185f5e214ce5aa.what: The body may remove some diabetes medicines faster, but the importance of this effect is uncertain.
2b8081e782c348a8fdc2d9702f185f5e214ce5aa.why: Changes in how acidic the urine is can change how quickly the kidneys remove these medicines.

8c8e79af053ef8f859d63736567cddabf57823bf.what: Unusual movements, muscle spasms, restlessness, or stiffness may become more likely or more severe.
8c8e79af053ef8f859d63736567cddabf57823bf.why: Both medicines can block the action of dopamine, a brain chemical that helps control movement.

20973c38f59103264f3e59cbddf070e5fa35c8ab.what: Apalutamide may reduce the amount and effect of certain other medicines.
20973c38f59103264f3e59cbddf070e5fa35c8ab.why: It can speed up processes that break down or remove those medicines. How much this matters depends on the other medicine.

b5cc73625798fa1dab780ebfd3f8e7a4f45d776f.what: For a scan using iodine-containing contrast injected into the blood, people taking metformin may need a specific medicine and kidney-check plan. The source describes a rare but serious acid buildup in the blood.
b5cc73625798fa1dab780ebfd3f8e7a4f45d776f.why: The contrast can affect kidney function. Kidney problems can increase the risk of this metformin-related complication. The care team must decide whether this applies; do not change treatment based on this app.

4cb59b935a1d0160f94cc3eeaf336e59d06fc3f6.what: Some usual signs of low blood sugar, such as shaking or a fast heartbeat, may be harder to notice. Low blood sugar can sometimes last longer.
4cb59b935a1d0160f94cc3eeaf336e59d06fc3f6.why: Beta-blocker medicines can reduce the body's warning response to low blood sugar and change how it recovers.

e18de8388ff7dca0871f9410432ed0560cd9cb70.what: The amount of an anti-inflammatory pain medicine in the blood may rise or fall. Reported changes have generally been small, and findings differ.
e18de8388ff7dca0871f9410432ed0560cd9cb70.why: The acid-reducing medicine may change how the pain medicine gets into, is broken down by, or leaves the body.
